headline: Mitsotakis: GSI proceeds without turbulence or concessions – We support as much as we can and as many as we can
summary: Greek Prime Minister Mitsotakis said the Greece–Cyprus electricity interconnection is proceeding without turbulence and without concessions on sovereign rights. The project continues under his government's stated position.
why: Power interconnectors link national grids, improving energy security and trade in electricity, and they are often financed through large public-private infrastructure deals.
